title: Polaroid Archive Studies
description: Nine independent faded 70s instant-film squares — each a different moment captured on sun-bleached chemistry with thick white borders, tape marks, and handwritten ballpoint notes, re-photographed at modern precision.
creative_direction: Every image is a single 70s instant-film square photographed face-up on a warm surface. Shared grammar: thick white bottom border with handwriting, chemistry color shift, soft focus drift, fingerprints and tape residue. Subjects vary widely — beach, kitchen, motel, party — but never the same person twice.
